run_validate_main: run the fairseq validation main function to evaluate a model on a dataset subset
run_cli_main: run the fairseq validation CLI entry point to parse args and validate a model
load_model_ensemble_and_task: load a fairseq model ensemble and task from a checkpoint path for validation
build_criterion: build a loss criterion from the task config for computing validation metrics
valid_step: compute the validation step loss and log output for a sample using the model and criterion
